svg.title: Order desk
svg.desc: Order desk. 11 components. Connections: Customer orders to Order desk; Order desk to Credit check; Credit check to Within limit?; Within limit? to Pick and pack (yes); Within limit? to Sales manager (no); Sales manager to Pick and pack (signs off); Sales manager to Order declined (declines); Pick and pack to Courier; Courier to Delivered; Pick and pack to Invoice; Invoice to Paid.

text.tspan: From order to delivered and paid; three steps use the team's own icons
